title: Road Blocked
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2.5 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq N \leq 300; 0 \leq M \leq \frac{N(N-1)}{2}; 1 \leq A_i < B_i \leq N; All pairs (A_i, B_i) are distinct.; 1 \leq C_i \leq 10^9; 1 \leq Q \leq 2 \times 10^5; In the queries of the first type, 1 \leq i \leq M.; The road given in a query of the first type is not already closed at that time.; The number of queries of the first type is at most 300.; In the queries of the second type, 1 \leq x < y \leq N.; All input values are integers.
